profile.subtitleJa: 主に属する霊として語られる存在
profile.summaryJa: オバデヤは、主の霊がエリヤを連れ去るかもしれないと恐れを語ります。本文はこの霊を「主の霊」と呼びます。
profile.identityNoteJa: 本文はここで「主の霊」と表現しています。

facts.textJa: ゼデキヤはミカヤに、主の霊が自分からどの道を通って語りかけたのかと問いかけました。

wikipedia.title: Holy Spirit in Judaism
wikipedia.noteJa: ユダヤ教における「神の霊」の語り方を扱う記事です。列王記上18:12の「主の霊」と後代の三位一体論を同一視する根拠にはなりません。
wikipedia.verifiedHeadingOrText: The article discusses Hebrew Bible expressions for God’s spirit in Judaism, but does not identify the specific 1 Kings 18:12 wording as a separate person.
wikipedia.evidenceLocator: “Spirit of God” section, lines 141–149 (also general framing at line 122)

sources.title: Wikipedia: Holy Spirit in Judaism
sources.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, “Holy Spirit in Judaism”, CC BY-SA 4.0.

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: It will happen, as soon as I leave you, that the LORD’s Spirit will carry you I don’t know where; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he can’t find you, he will kill me. But I, your servant, have feared the LORD from my youth.
Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, “Which way did the LORD’s Spirit go from me to speak to you?”
